item.title: What is NFC on phones and how do I use it?
item.description: Discover what NFC means on your phone and how to use it for contactless payments, device pairing, and more. Learn how to enable NFC and stay secure.

item.title: New Galaxy Chromebooks buyers will get free 12-month GeForce Now access
item.description: Google has announced that all new Chromebook buyers will get free access to a 12-month subscription to Nvidia GeForce Now.

item.title: A new sports app is now available on Samsung TVs globally
item.description: SQUASHTV is now available globally on select Samsung smart TVs, offering live events, on-demand content, and exclusive features.

item.title: Start of a new era at Samsung: TM Roh takes charge of DX business
item.description: Samsung has announced major changes to its leadership where it has named TM Roh at the Head of the DX Division and the brand's co-CEO.

item.title: Samsung TVs get two new AI voice games
item.description: Volley Games has launched the Volley app on Samsung TVs. It offers two AI voice games, Song Quiz and Jeopardy!

item.title: Galaxy Tab A9's One UI 8 update reaches India
item.description: Samsung has released a new software update to the Galaxy Tab A9 in India. It offers One UI 8.0 (Android 16).

item.title: Galaxy S20 users may want to pass the torch to the Galaxy S25 right away
item.description: Galaxy S20 users may find it’s finally time to pass the torch to the S25, with major performance gains, Galaxy AI, and Black Friday deals.

item.title: How your Galaxy S21 Ultra was handicapped by Samsung for no apparent reason
item.description: Despite being near-perfect, the Galaxy S21 Ultra was held back by a downgrade nobody but Samsung understood. The Note 20 Ultra was the same.

item.title: Right now is the perfect moment for Apple fans to try a Galaxy foldable
item.description: Apple fans might never get a better moment to try a Galaxy Z foldable. Here's why now is the ideal time to experience something different.

item.title: How do phone microphones capture clear audio?
item.description: Discover how phone microphones use MEMS technology, beamforming, and AI algorithms to capture crystal-clear audio while blocking background noise during calls and recordings.
